result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signage. While the low-density setting suggests lower traffic speeds, the environment provides no formal protection or designated space for pedestrians to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are present to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing activity.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility impairments or strollers.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and mature trees at the corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Patchy and uneven asphalt surfaces could present a tripping hazard for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct concrete curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim back corner vegetation to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, unpaved or poorly maintained residential road with a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. Dense vegetation along the roadside creates significant visual obstructions, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with vehicles in an environment with poor sight lines.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or designated walking area, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Dense hedges and trees at the road edge significantly limit sight lines for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Surface Condition
hazards.description: The unpaved and uneven road surface presents trip hazards and difficult walking conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the road

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk or a separated walking path to provide a safe space for pedestrians away from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back hedges and low-hanging tree branches to improve sight lines at potential crossing points and along the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during nighttime or low-light conditions.

result.summary: A quiet residential street with a narrow sidewalk separated from the roadway by a tall hedge. The environment lacks formal crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the intersection of the sidewalk and driveway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges along the sidewalk block sightlines between pedestrians and vehicles entering or exiting driveways.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The transition from the sidewalk to the driveway/road surface lacks a sloped ramp, creating a barrier for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground where sidewalk meets the paved area

interventions.title: Install Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Provide ADA-compliant curb ramps at all sidewalk-to-roadway transitions.

interventions.title: Daylighting/Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim hedges near driveway and road intersections to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks. While the low-speed residential character is a positive, the absence of designated pedestrian space and potential sightline obstructions from mature vegetation create a vulnerable environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps forces pedestrians to cross the roadway without designated space or accessibility features.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and mature trees at the corners may block visibility between drivers and pedestrians approaching the intersection.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct continuous, standard-width sidewalks to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians along the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim vegetation near the intersection to improve sightlines between all road users.
